text:
mira: Drafted release notes for the routing + batching tweaks and pushed to GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/507. Main asks: check SDK snippets, call out deprecated integrations, and add a short known-issues section.

ben: On it. Quick scan found a deprecated mention of `redis-prefix-cache` in the dep graph paragraph. We replaced that with `unified-kv-cache` last quarter. Recommend a deprecation banner with a migration link.

toni: I'll update snippets. FYI the Python example uses `model='kestrel'` which should be `kestrel-v2`. JS snippets too. Small patch incoming.

ryan: Also flagging a UX note: the routing policy table references latency SLOs but doesn't mention fallback behavior. CS asked for an explicit one-liner so support isn't surprised.

mira: Good call. Add bullet: "Fallbacks: requests may be routed to compatible variants during autoscale cold starts (see INF-3124)". Keep it short.

ben: Running linkcheck now: `./tools/linkcheck docs/relnotes --output=reports/relnotes-links.json`. Will post results.

publish-bot: PR #507 updated by mira — changed files: docs/relnotes/2024-08-routing-batching.md, snippets/js/kestrel_usage.md. CI: linkcheck queued.

toni: PR #508 opened to switch snippet models to `kestrel-v2` and to update client examples for Python/JS. Includes tests for snippet rendering.

ben: Linkcheck results: 2 broken anchors, 1 external link redirect. I created PR #509 with anchor fixes + suggested redirects.

mira: Thanks. For external redirect let's add a tiny note rather than changing the canonical link so old customer docs still resolve. e.g., "Note: this link redirects to X; if you need the old anchor contact support."

ryan: Draft wording for the known issue (can copy into relnotes):
```
Known issue: routing fallback during cold starts
- Symptom: some requests may be briefly served by fallback variants under high concurrency
- Mitigation: pin model_variant for dedicated routes or increase warm pool size
- Tracking: INF-3124
```

mira: I'll paste that verbatim. Also adding a deprecation row for `redis-prefix-cache` with migration steps and a one-line compatibility note.

toni: JP localization — I can prep the i18n stub once anchors are stable. Where should I put it? /i18n/jp/relnotes/ ?

ben: Yes `/i18n/jp/relnotes/2024-08-routing.md`. Wait until PR #509 merges then run linkcheck again.

publish-bot: PR #509 merged by ben — anchors fixed. Linkcheck green on staging.

mira: Final pre-publish checklist:
- [x] Deprecation note added for redis-prefix-cache
- [x] SDK snippets updated (PY/JS) via #508
- [x] Known issue blurb added (INF-3124)
- [x] Linkcheck green on staging
- [ ] JP localization PR pending (toni)

toni: I will open JP PR in ~3 hours. If not done by EOD we can ship EN relnotes and follow-up with JP patch.

mira: OK — shipping plan: publish EN relnotes at 18:00 UTC if JP not ready, otherwise include translations. I'll coordinate the announcement post once status is final. Thanks all. :rocket:
